name: Alright - New File
description:
Create new files right where you work in Finder.

Add a folder in Alright, enable its Finder extension, then right-click empty space in that folder and choose Alright and a document type. Your new file appears in Finder, ready to rename with Return.

Choose from 16 formats:
TXT, Markdown, RTF, PDF, Word (DOCX), Excel (XLSX), PowerPoint (PPTX), OpenDocument Text (ODT), Spreadsheet (ODS), Presentation (ODP), JSON, CSV, HTML, SVG, Photoshop (PSD), and Illustrator (AI).

Create a quick note, start a document, or prepare a blank design file without opening an editor first. Alright keeps existing files and adds a number when a name is already in use.

You choose the folders Alright can use. No account is required.

Requires macOS 14 or later and an Apple silicon Mac.
